cat > /home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f9dbd755.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            if grid[y][x] == 0 or (y, x) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(y, x)]
            seen.add((y, x))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                a, b = stack.pop()
                cells.append((a, b))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (a + dy, b + dx)
                    if 0 <= p[0] < h and 0 <= p[1] < w and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] != 0:
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            colors = {grid[a][b] for a, b in cells}
            boxes = []
            for c in colors:
                pts = [(a, b) for a, b in cells if grid[a][b] == c]
                area = (max(a for a, b in pts) - min(a for a, b in pts) + 1) * (max(b for a, b in pts) - min(b for a, b in pts) + 1)
                boxes.append((area, c))
            order = [c for _, c in sorted(boxes, reverse=True)]
            mapping = {c: order[-1-i] for i, c in enumerate(order)}
            for a, b in cells:
                out[a][b] = mapping[grid[a][b]]
    return out
PY
